items.definitionEn: A toolchain covering AUTOSAR authoring, BSW configuration, RTE generation, compilation, analysis, static analysis, and coverage.

items.questionEn: What is DaVinci Developer used for?

items.definitionEn: An AUTOSAR authoring tool similar to DaVinci, with focus on BSW configuration.
items.explanationVi: Tool authoring tương tự DaVinci, tập trung vào cấu hình BSW.

items.definitionEn: Vector tool for configuring AUTOSAR BSW modules such as OS, Com, NvM, and DEM.

items.definitionEn: Vector tools for analyzing CAN, LIN, and Ethernet traffic and simulating an ECU.
items.explanationVi: Tool Vector để phân tích traffic CAN/LIN/Ethernet và simulate ECU.
items.questionEn: What are CANoe and CANalyzer used for?

items.definitionEn: Static analysis tools for MISRA C checking and runtime error detection.
items.explanationVi: Tool static analysis để kiểm tra MISRA C và phát hiện runtime errors.
items.questionEn: What does Polyspace check?

items.definitionEn: A tool for measuring code coverage for ASIL.
items.explanationVi: Tool dùng để đo code coverage cho ASIL.

items.explanationVi: Task có priority cao hơn có thể preempt task có priority thấp hơn.

items.explanationVi: SC3 và SC4 có Memory Protection với tích hợp MPU.

items.definitionEn: A point in a Schedule Table where a configured action, such as task activation, occurs.
items.explanationVi: Mốc thời gian trong Schedule Table tại đó thực hiện action đã cấu hình, ví dụ activate task.
items.questionEn: What happens at an Expiry Point?

source.section: Ví dụ OS configuration thực tế

items.definitionEn: Non-volatile Memory Management, a BSW module managing EEPROM and Flash read/write operations.
items.explanationVi: Non-volatile Memory Management, BSW module quản lý đọc/ghi EEPROM và Flash.
items.questionEn: What does NvM stand for?

items.definitionEn: An asynchronous request to read one configured block from EEPROM or Flash.
items.explanationVi: API async yêu cầu đọc một block từ EEPROM hoặc Flash.
items.questionEn: What does NvM_ReadBlock() do?

items.definitionEn: An asynchronous request to write one block to EEPROM or Flash.
items.explanationVi: API async yêu cầu ghi một block vào EEPROM hoặc Flash.
items.questionEn: What does NvM_WriteBlock() do?

items.definitionEn: An asynchronous request to read all configured blocks during startup.
items.explanationVi: API async đọc tất cả configured blocks, thường dùng trong EcuM startup phase.
items.questionEn: When is NvM_ReadAll() used?

items.definitionEn: An asynchronous request to write all modified blocks during shutdown.
items.explanationVi: API async ghi các configured blocks đã modified, thường dùng trong EcuM shutdown phase.
items.questionEn: When is NvM_WriteAll() used?

items.definitionEn: A synchronous API that gets the status of the last block operation.
items.explanationVi: API sync lấy status của block sau khi job đã hoàn thành.
items.questionEn: What does NvM_GetErrorStatus() provide?

items.definitionEn: A synchronous API used to mark a RAM block as changed or dirty.
items.explanationVi: API sync đánh dấu RAM block đã thay đổi, tức dirty, trước NvM_WriteAll().
items.questionEn: What does NvM_SetRamBlockStatus() mark?

items.definitionEn: Read and write requests are asynchronous; completion and status are handled after the job finishes.
items.explanationVi: Read/Write gửi yêu cầu async; kết quả được xử lý sau khi job hoàn thành.
items.questionEn: Why are NvM Read/Write APIs important to understand as asynchronous?

items.definitionEn: RAM storage used by the application for NvM-managed block data.
items.explanationVi: Vùng RAM chứa dữ liệu block để application sử dụng và NvM đọc/ghi theo cấu hình.
items.questionEn: What is the RAM mirror used for in the NvM example?

items.definitionEn: A RAM block marked as changed so NvM_WriteAll() can process it for storage.
items.explanationVi: Block trong RAM đã thay đổi và được đánh dấu dirty để NvM_WriteAll() xử lý ghi.
items.questionEn: Why is a RAM block marked dirty?

items.definitionEn: Diagnostic Communication Manager, the AUTOSAR component handling UDS requests from external testers.
items.explanationVi: Diagnostic Communication Manager, thành phần xử lý các yêu cầu UDS từ tester bên ngoài.
items.questionEn: What does DCM stand for?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to switch between diagnostic sessions such as Default, Programming, and Extended.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x10 dùng để chuyển diagnostic session như Default, Programming và Extended.
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x10 do?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to reset the ECU, including hard, soft, or power-off reset types.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x11 dùng để reset ECU, gồm hard, soft hoặc power-off reset.
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x11 do?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to read data identified by a DID, such as sensor values or parameters.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x22 đọc dữ liệu theo DID, ví dụ sensor values hoặc parameters.
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x22 read?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to write data identified by a DID, such as calibration or configuration.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x2E ghi dữ liệu theo DID, ví dụ calibration hoặc configuration.
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x2E write?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to read Diagnostic Trouble Codes.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x19 dùng để đọc Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs).
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x19 provide?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to clear Diagnostic Trouble Codes.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x14 dùng để xóa thông tin DTC.
items.questionEn: What does UDS service 0x14 do?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to start, stop, or obtain the result of a routine.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x31 dùng để start, stop hoặc lấy kết quả của một routine.
items.questionEn: What can UDS service 0x31 control?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to begin a flash programming download sequence.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x34 dùng để bắt đầu flash programming sequence.
items.questionEn: What is UDS service 0x34 used for?

items.definitionEn: UDS service used to unlock protected services using a seed/key mechanism.
items.explanationVi: Service UDS 0x27 dùng seed/key để unlock các protected services.
items.questionEn: What is UDS service 0x27 used for?

items.definitionEn: An AUTOSAR platform designed for high-performance ECUs in ADAS, autonomous driving, and central compute platforms.
items.explanationVi: Nền tảng AUTOSAR cho High-Performance ECU, ADAS, Autonomous Driving và central compute.
items.questionEn: What is AUTOSAR Adaptive designed for?

items.definitionEn: Classic uses AUTOSAR OS based on OSEK; Adaptive uses POSIX systems such as Linux, QNX, or Integrity.
items.explanationVi: Classic dùng AUTOSAR OS/OSEK; Adaptive dùng POSIX như Linux, QNX hoặc Integrity.
items.questionEn: How do Classic and Adaptive differ in OS?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Classic primarily uses C, while Adaptive uses C++14/17 according to the source comparison.
items.explanationVi: Classic dùng C; Adaptive dùng C++14/17 theo bảng so sánh trong tài liệu.
items.questionEn: What languages are associated with Classic and Adaptive?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Classic uses signal-based communication with Com; Adaptive uses service-oriented communication with ara::com and SOME/IP.
items.explanationVi: Classic giao tiếp signal-based qua Com; Adaptive hướng service-oriented qua ara::com và SOME/IP.
items.questionEn: How does communication differ between Classic and Adaptive?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Classic is mainly static at compile time; Adaptive supports dynamic runtime service discovery.
items.explanationVi: Classic chủ yếu static ở compile-time; Adaptive hỗ trợ dynamic runtime service discovery.
items.questionEn: How do Classic and Adaptive differ in architecture?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Classic mainly uses static allocation; Adaptive permits dynamic memory according to the source.
items.explanationVi: Classic chủ yếu static allocation; Adaptive cho phép dynamic memory.
items.questionEn: How does memory allocation differ between Classic and Adaptive?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.term: ECU Flash vs OTA Application Update
items.definitionEn: Classic uses full ECU flash updates; Adaptive supports OTA updates of individual applications.
items.explanationVi: Classic cập nhật bằng full ECU flash; Adaptive hỗ trợ OTA update từng Application.
items.questionEn: How does software update differ between Classic and Adaptive?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Use Adaptive when high processing power, flexible OTA, service-oriented architecture, or Linux is needed.
items.explanationVi: Dùng Adaptive khi cần processing power lớn, OTA linh hoạt, SOA hoặc ECU chạy Linux.
items.questionEn: When does the source recommend considering Adaptive?

source.section: Kiến trúc AUTOSAR Adaptive — Tương lai

items.definitionEn: Keep Classic when strict hard real-time deadlines, ASIL D requirements, resource constraints, or legacy integration dominate.
items.explanationVi: Giữ Classic khi cần hard real-time nghiêm ngặt, ASIL D, tài nguyên hạn chế hoặc legacy integration.
items.questionEn: When does the source recommend keeping Classic?
